recipe.name: Coconut Pineapple Steaks Flambéed with Dark Rum
directions: Preheat the grill to screaming hot

Place the sugar in a shallow bowl and stir in the cinnamon with a fork. Arrange the pineapple slices on a large plate. Brush the tops with coconut milk. Invert the slices and brush with coconut milk again.
Soon the ice cream into bowl and keep cold in the freezer.

Brush and oil the grill grate. Dip each pineapple slice in the cinnamon sugar on both sides (use tongs or a fork), shaking off the excess. Arrange the pineapple slices on the grill grate. Grill until caramelized (dark brown) on both side, about 5 minutes per side. (Give each slice a quarter turn half way through to lay on a crosshatch of grill marks.)
Transfer the grilled pineapple to the bowls with the ice cream.
Heat the rum in a small saucepan until warm, almost hot, but do not let boil. Touch a match to the rum and pour it over the pineapple. Serve at once.
